name: dsh-intelhub:个人情报站
title_zh: 刷过的信息自动长成带出处的个人知识库
tagline_zh: 刷到的好内容不再沉底——语义+关键词混合检索，每条都带原始出处；Obsidian 反哺笔记。
tagline_en: Good finds never sink again—hybrid semantic+keyword search with source links, Obsidian round-trip, zero daemon.
desc_en: 个人情报站:刷到的信息自动沉淀为可检索知识库——语义+关键词混合检索带出处,Obsidian 反哺,零守护进程零 API key | IntelHub: the first zvec-native personal intel station for DeepSeek Harness
why_zh: 首创 zvec-native 存储，检索时语义与关键词互为兜底；出处随条附赠。
why_en: First zvec-native store: semantic and keyword search back each other up; every hit carries its source; Obsidian round-trip turns.
limit_zh: 只消化你主动喂给它的文本（链接/剪藏/粘贴），不监听浏览器或社交流；检索质量依赖本地 zvec 索引。
limit_en: Only ingests text you feed it (links/clips/pastes)—no browser or feed listening; first index build takes minutes; no summarization or Q&A, just.
title_en: Scrolled info auto-grows into a cited personal knowledge.
